$comment: Evil Eye's destinations (Demonic Pacts tier 3; docs/leagues.md), by the item's area submenu (the cache's subops, in their order; `area` is the league area's id, league-areas.json). The rows and their order are the Wiki's (Evil_Eye_(Demonic_Pacts_League), 'Teleports by Area', read 2026-11-02), Barrows twice (its chest and its surface) and each Moon of Peril on its own. The Wiki's pins mark the dungeon's surface for many bosses 'inside' one; the relic goes to 'the entrance of' the boss, so each tile is one the server's own data gives for it (`source`): the tile its lair's or raid's code puts a player outside the entrance, else the open tile before the entrance loc on the cache's map, else the Wiki's pin where that is the entrance; each is open floor on the cache's map with 30 or more tiles walkable from it, or the whole of a small room before the entrance (the Mimic's, Sarachnis' and the Moons' antechambers). None of the Wiki's rows is left out. The menus are live's (interface 187, 237/01104, 01106, 01107, 01133, 04057, 04070, 04099): `region` is the area's name on 'Select a region' where it differs from the submenu's, `label` the destination's on 'Evil Eye teleports - <region>' where live's differs from the Wiki's, and the five captured areas (Kandarin, Karamja, Morytania, Tirannwn, Varlamore) list in live's order. Requirements past the area (kill counts, keys, tasks, quests) are the bosses' own, met or refused at the entrance.
